title: Effective mentalisation and somatic stress: correlations and effects
summary: In this study, we examine whether the induction of affective mentalisation is associated with a reduction in state-related physical stress in a German clinical sample.

interventions.name: Intervention to teach affective mentalisation skills (a person with mentalising traits responds to the participants' current physical stress by mentalising)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of F45 (somatoform disorders)
Exclusion criteria:
hypochondria
